description: Source code for the ImageProcessor class in the media GPU ChromeOS module, handling video frame processing, format validation, and callback management.

classes.name: ImageProcessor
classes.description: Handles video frame processing, format validation, callback management, and resource cleanup within the media GPU ChromeOS context.

classes.name: ImageProcessor::ClientCallback
classes.description: Encapsulates callback functions for processed frames, supporting both modern and legacy callback types.

methods.name: CheckVideoFrameFormat
methods.description: Validates if a VideoFrame matches the specified PortConfig format, size, and visible rect.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an ImageProcessor with specified configurations and backend creation callback.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes input and output VideoFrames asynchronously, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: ProcessLegacy
methods.description: Processes a VideoFrame using legacy callback mechanism.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the processor, clearing pending callbacks and resetting backend state.

methods.name: StoreCallback
methods.description: Stores a callback and returns its associated index for tracking.
